title: AACVD Protocol for Fabricating CuO and Co3O4 Nanostructured Coatings
author: Vázquez-Vargas, Pizá-Ruiz, et al.

steps.title: Clean stainless steel substrate
steps.instruction: Wash a 2.5 × 2.5 cm stainless‑steel sheet with water and phosphate‑free soap, rinse with water, ultrasonicate 20 min in acetone, ultrasonicate 20 min in methanol, then dry and store to avoid contamination.

substeps.instruction: Wash with water and phosphate‑free soap.
Place in ultrasonic bath with acetone for 20 min.
Remove acetone, ultrasonicate in methanol for 20 min.
Remove methanol, dry the sheet, and store.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M precursor solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve the metal salts in methanol to obtain two separate 0.1 M solutions: copper(II) nitrate hemi‑pentahydrate for CuO and cobalt(II) acetate tetrahydrate for Co₃O₄.

substeps.instruction: Weigh copper(II) nitrate hemi‑pentahydrate and dissolve in methanol to 0.1 M.
Weigh cobalt(II) acetate tetrahydrate and dissolve in methanol to 0.1 M.

steps.title: Assemble AACVD system
steps.instruction: Couple the ultrasonic nebulizer to the translation‑nozzle assembly, connect clean filtered air as carrier gas to the nebulizer, and verify all accessories are securely attached.

substeps.instruction: Attach nebulizer to translation system with nozzle.
Connect carrier‑gas line (filtered air) to nebulizer.

steps.title: Stabilize system temperature
steps.instruction: Turn on the fume hood, place the cleaned substrate on the heating plate, set the substrate temperature to 350 °C, and power the heating system.

substeps.instruction: Turn on fume hood to stabilize ambient temperature.

steps.title: Start carrier‑gas flow
steps.instruction: Introduce filtered air at a flow rate of 5 L min⁻¹ and allow the gas stream to thermally stabilize.

steps.title: Introduce precursor into nebulizer
steps.instruction: Pour the appropriate 0.1 M precursor solution (Cu or Co) into the nebulizer reservoir once the substrate and gas streams have reached steady state.

steps.title: Set nozzle displacement speed
steps.instruction: Program the translation stage to move the nozzle at 0.1 mm s⁻¹.

steps.title: Generate aerosol cloud
steps.instruction: Switch on the ultrasonic nebulizer to create a micrometric aerosol of the precursor solution.

steps.title: Begin deposition motion
steps.instruction: Start the nozzle displacement so the aerosol stream contacts the heated substrate; the aerosol pre‑heats below the deposition temperature before reaching the surface, enabling thermal decomposition and coating growth.

steps.title: Extract residual gases continuously
steps.instruction: Keep the fume hood extracting gases (H₂O, CO₂, NO₂, etc.) produced by precursor decomposition throughout the deposition to maintain a clean environment.

steps.title: Shutdown and cool system
steps.instruction: After the desired coating thickness is reached, turn off the AACVD equipment and the fume hood, then allow the substrate and system to cool to room temperature before handling the coated sample.
